prose.subject: Payment Required: Access Shipment Analytics Report
prose.body:
Your request for the detailed shipment analytics report is ready, but a small payment is required to unlock full access. This report contains your complete logistics performance metrics, including average delivery times, exception rates, and cost-per-mile breakdowns for the last quarter. It is designed to help you identify bottlenecks and optimize your routing strategies effectively.

The total price for this report is 5478.38 USDC. Please ensure your wallet has sufficient balance before proceeding. Once payment is confirmed, the report will be available for immediate download in your dashboard.

To complete the purchase, send the amount to the following address:
0x311ef55dd35c4162064c8c4e35245d2e1e1d06b5

After the transaction is confirmed on the network, you will receive an automatic email notification with a link to access your data. If you have any questions about the report contents or the payment process, please contact our support team at Quillon Logistics. We appreciate your business and look forward to helping you improve your logistics operations.
